intelligence.child_view: Imagine you build a beautiful toy castle, but you only ever check it from far away with a telescope. That's mobile first: the phone is the hands; the laptop is the telescope.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, he said it plainly: the phone comes first. Everything we build has to feel right in your hand, on your phone, before it matters how it looks on a big computer screen.
